cross_checks: ADB connection/authentication, specific device selection and existing Chrome tab selection are separate prerequisites
Source input command behavior makes UI mutation distinct from screenshot or help observation
USB debug transport does not imply the phone application's external network path changed or that mobile-data use was verified
Current main AOSP support does not establish installed-device support; actual help/version and matching screenshot must be checked
ADB alone cannot certify multi-touch gestures from the reviewed single-pointer implementation

Later explicit current-phone USB-local test authorization changes the permitted test scope, while preserving the original error phone and preventing local-test success from being described as an external-network fix.
